title: Custom Views | Date-time today/yesterday/tomorrow use the UTC day instead of the tenant time zone
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) · account ndc-staging-owner (CRM Admin)

Same view with Yesterday: only L1 (17 Oct 23:50 Cairo).
Same view with Tomorrow: only L4 (19 Oct 00:10 Cairo).
